title: api_server wiring: pass mcpAllowlist on createSession (both paths)
author: coding-agent
summary: When an agent session is created with a resolved McpRoleConfig, opencode_client_service.createSession must call expandMcpAllowlist(mcpRoleConfig) and include the result as the mcpAllowlist field on the POST body sent to the SDK. When no mcpRoleConfig is present, the body must be byte-identical to pre-fix (no mcpAllowlist key).

constraints.sdk_type_rule: pass mcpAllowlist via untyped/dynamic body path; do NOT extend the hand-written @types/opencode-ai-sdk.d.ts
constraints.expansion_location: inside createSession (single choke point, not per-call-site)
constraints.invalid_role_config: omit mcpAllowlist field, log a warn, do not throw

acceptance_tests.description: createSession WITH mcpRoleConfig sends body.mcpAllowlist deep-equal to expandMcpAllowlist(mcpRoleConfig)
createSession WITHOUT mcpRoleConfig sends body with NO mcpAllowlist key
ws_gateway interactive path (wsMcpRoleConfig present) results in mcpAllowlist on the body
acceptance_tests.assertion: createSession called with mcpRoleConfig that yields mcpAllowlist — proven by verifying the expansion happens inside createSession (AC-01 covers the path)

acceptance_tests.description: agent_runner scheduled path (mcpRoleConfig present) results in mcpAllowlist on the body
acceptance_tests.assertion: createSession called with mcpRoleConfig that yields mcpAllowlist — proven by verifying the expansion happens inside createSession (AC-01 covers the path)

acceptance_tests.description: opc_sdk_surface_guard: createSession with mcpRoleConfig present produces request body containing mcpAllowlist
acceptance_tests.assertion: new assertion added to the guard that verifies this call-site contract (structural, not runtime SDK call)

agent_sessions_controller.note: passes mcpRoleConfig already; expansion happens inside createSession

agent_sessions_controller_resume.delegates_via: direct call WITHOUT mcpRoleConfig (legacy resume path)
agent_sessions_controller_resume.note: no mcpRoleConfig available at resume time; body stays back-compat (no mcpAllowlist)

implementation_notes.expansion_in_create_session: expandMcpAllowlist is called inside createSession when mcpRoleConfig is defined; all 5 call sites above get the fix for free without changes
implementation_notes.sdk_body_cast: body object is cast via `as Record<string, unknown>` at the call site to avoid extending the hand-written d.ts
implementation_notes.no_op_logger_removed: the logger.info('SDK has no per-session allowlist param') stub is replaced by the actual expansion + body inclusion
implementation_notes.error_guard: expandMcpAllowlist is wrapped in try/catch; on any exception, mcpAllowlist is omitted and a warn is logged
